name: Security update timeframe
verbatim_text: be updated, including vulnerability fixes, within 14 days* of release

name: Vulnerability severity threshold
value: CVSS v3 base score of 7 or above
verbatim_text: the update addresses vulnerabilities with a CVSS v3 base score of 7 or above

name: Single update containing critical or high risk issues
verbatim_text: If such an update covers any ‘critical’ or ‘high risk’ issues then it must be installed within 14 days.

name: Device unlocking brute-force throttling
value: no more than 10 guesses in 5 minutes
verbatim_text: You should allow no more than 10 guesses in 5 minutes

name: Device lockout
verbatim_text: locking devices after no more than 10 unsuccessful attempts

name: Device unlocking credential length
verbatim_text: If credentials are just to unlock a device, use a minimum password or PIN length of at least 6 characters.

name: MFA password element length
verbatim_text: The password element of the multi-factor authentication approach must have a password length of at least 8 characters, with no maximum length restrictions.

name: Password brute-force throttling
value: no more than 10 guesses in 5 minutes
verbatim_text: You should allow no more than 10 guesses in 5 minutes

name: Password lockout
verbatim_text: locking devices after no more than 10 unsuccessful attempts

name: Minimum password length without deny list
verbatim_text: A minimum password length of at least 12 characters, with no maximum length restrictions

name: Minimum password length with deny list
verbatim_text: A minimum password length of at least 8 characters, with no maximum length restrictions and use automatic blocking of common passwords using a deny list

name: Password composition guidance
verbatim_text: encouraging people to choose longer passwords by promoting the use of multiple words (a minimum of three) to create a password
